r2.decision: 12000 completed 13/36 windows vs 14/36 at 6000 and hit 0 reference pairs; output cap did not restore completeness. Stop tuning. Final planned window was interrupted after budget reservation; retained as failed, no retry or fabricated response.

final: No discovery gain in any single-variable round. Defaults remain legacy context and thinking disabled. No new-sample validation was started because the predeclared gain condition was not met.
